question: By what percentage of the bare-Al value did the carbon layer reduce the sodium nucleation overpotential?
rendered: According to the text, the bare-Al nucleation overpotential was 19 mV, and the carbon/Al nucleation overpotential was 12 mV. Therefore, the carbon layer reduced the nucleation overpotential by 19 - 12 = 7 mV. To express this as a percentage of the bare-Al value, we can divide by the bare-Al value and multiply by 100: (7 mV / 19 mV) * 100 = 36.8%.
